description: This PHP class 'AboutOrganization' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) that encapsulates information about an organization, including company name, version, number of active employees, and number of past employees. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: AboutOrganization
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class representing organization information, including company name, version, and employee counts.

methods.name: getNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of active employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of active employees.

methods.name: getNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of past employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of past employees.
